decision: D-10 session policy approved 2026-11-07; D-14 password, hashing and rate-limit policy approved by owner 2026-11-17. D-14 is normative for REM-WP5.

session.representation: opaque server-side session; browser receives no bearer token in JSON, URL or persistent storage

forced_change_allowlist.purpose: read minimal session state and current CSRF token

rate_limit.delay_combination: calculate account and trusted-source delay independently and apply the greater active delay, not the sum
rate_limit.failure_expiry: each failure ages out exactly 900 seconds after occurrence
rate_limit.source_resolution: socket peer unless explicitly trusted proxy configuration resolves it; never trust arbitrary forwarding headers
rate_limit.storage: shared atomic store across API instances; no process-local-only counters

password_policy.compromised_password_check: versioned local blocklist; no external candidate-password lookup
password_policy.standards_note: 12-code-point minimum is below NIST SP 800-63B-4 single-factor SHALL minimum of 15; no NIST minimum-length conformance claim

runtime_evidence_owner: REM-WP5.1-REM-WP5.5; REM-WP0 tests pure policy and boundaries only
